.java.description: Enterprise Java framework for APIs, services, and microservices.
conversion_guidance: Generate complete buildable project structure with pom.xml or build.gradle.
Use layered architecture: controller, service, repository, domain/entity, DTO.
Use validation annotations and explicit request/response DTO boundaries.
Configure profiles and application properties for environment separation.
Include exception handling via @ControllerAdvice and standardized error responses.
